extracted.intended_audience: NLP / computational-linguistics researchers and practitioners working on automatic evaluation of story generation
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluation of generated stories using automatic metrics and human dimensions; surveys metric types, frameworks, and common human-evaluation criteria used in story generation research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Character Consistency
rubrics_metrics.description: characters behave/sound the same across the story
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether characters' actions, speech, and personality remain consistent through the narrative; important for believability and continuity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plot Progression
rubrics_metrics.description: events build causally toward an outcome
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate causal chaining and whether events meaningfully advance the story to an outcome; checks for logical event sequencing and purposeful development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emotional & Psychological Realism
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measure whether characters' emotions and psychological reactions feel realistic and appropriate to events; relates to empathy and emotional resonance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Continuity & Consistency in Story Elements
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check for contradictions in facts, objects, settings, timelines, and other story elements across the narrative to ensure internal coherence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coherence
rubrics_metrics.description: semantic and discourse-level connection across sentences
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess logical and semantic connections at discourse level, including topic continuity, referential cohesion, and overall narrative sense-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engagement / Interestingness
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Human-centric quality: measures how compelling, surprising, or engaging a story is; often requires human judgment as automatic metrics struggle to capture it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fluency
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate grammaticality, naturalness, and readability of sentences; commonly approximated by language-model-based measures like perplexity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversity
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measure variety in word choice and syntactic constructions; important to avoid repetition and blandness in generated text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Checks whether the generated story stays on-topic relative to a given prompt or premise; frequently used both in automatic and human evaluations.

rubrics_metrics.name: BERTScore
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Computes similarity between candidate and reference using contextual embeddings (BERT); captures semantic overlap beyond exact n-gram matches.

rubrics_metrics.name: BERT Next Sentence Prediction
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Uses next-sentence-prediction capability of models like BERT to evaluate whether consecutive sentences coherently follow one another; focuses on local discourse coherence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entity-Grid Coherence
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Model of coherence based on patterns of entity mentions across sentences (entity grid); evaluates whether entities are introduced and maintained in a coherent way.

rubrics_metrics.name: Perplexity
rubrics_metrics.description: fluency proxy via language model probability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lower perplexity implies more probable (thus more fluent) text under a given language model; widely used as an automatic fluency measure but has limitations as proxy for quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: BLEU / ROUGE / METEOR (n-gram overlap metrics)
rubrics_metrics.description: n-gram overlap (poor for stories, but often reported)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compute n-gram precision/recall against reference texts; commonly reported for comparability but known to be poor indicators of open-ended narrative quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: MAUVE
rubrics_metrics.description: distributional similarity between human and machine text
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measures divergence between distributions of human-written and model-generated text; intended to capture overall similarity in quality/style at distribution level.

rubrics_metrics.name: NCI / NCI-2.0
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Metrics designed to quantify aspects of narrative coherence; used to estimate how well events and discourse form a coherent narrative.

rubrics_metrics.name: EASM
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measures similarity between emotional trajectories (affect arcs) in generated stories and reference or canonical emotional arcs; used to assess emotional consistency or intended affective patterns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discriminator-based metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: train a BERT/RoBERTa classifier to distinguish good vs. bad stories
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Train discriminative models on labeled or synthetic negative examples to produce a learned quality score; effectiveness depends on training data and negative-example design.

rubrics_metrics.name: StoryER framework
rubrics_metrics.description: automatic story evaluation via Ranking, Rating, and Reasoning
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Framework presented at EMNLP 2022 that combines multiple evaluation modes (ranking, rating, and reasoning) for assessing story quality automatically; emphasizes multi-faceted assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: HANNA benchmark
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides human annotations across six dimensions: Relevance, Coherence, Empathy, Surprise, Engagement, Complexity — used for training/evaluating metrics aligned to human judgments.

rubrics_metrics.name: TTCW tests
rubrics_metrics.description: 14 binary expert tests across 4 Torrance dimensions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expert-designed binary tests (pass/fail) spanning Torrance creativity dimensions; intended for targeted expert evaluation of creativity-related aspects of generated narratives.

rubrics_metrics.name: OpenMEVA
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Benchmark for evaluating evaluation methods themselves (meta-evaluation), especially for open-ended generation tasks like storytelling; helps compare how well metrics correlate with human judgments.

rubrics_metrics.name: UNION metric
rubrics_metrics.description: unreferenced metric trained on synthetic negatives
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A metric that does not require references; trained using synthetic negative examples to learn a quality signal for generated text without relying on gold references.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metric-Human Alignment Limitation
rubrics_metrics.description: "Many automatic metrics do not align well with human preferences."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Key limitation noted: automatic metrics often fail to capture human notions of interestingness or overall narrative quality, so human evaluation remains required for many qualities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevance to prompt (human evaluation)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of the most-used human-evaluation dimensions: judges whether the story responds appropriately to the given prompt or constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coherence (human evaluation)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Human raters judge logical flow and sense-making across the narrative; overlaps with but is not fully captured by many automatic coherence metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fluency (human evaluation)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Human judgments of grammaticality and stylistic smoothness; complements automatic proxies like perplexity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interestingness / Engagement (human evaluation)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Human-centric assessment of how engaging or compelling a story is; frequently reported and often poorly matched by automatic measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Empathy / Emotional resonance (human evaluation)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Human ratings of how emotionally resonant or empathetic the story feels; relates to emotional arc and realism metrics but often requires human judgment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Surprise / Originality (human evaluation)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measures whether the narrative contains novel or surprising elements; important for creativity but challenging for automatic metrics to capture reliably.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complexity (human evaluation)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judges the depth or sophistication of theme, characters, and plot; typically assessed by humans rather than automatic metrics.
